description: Edits an existing TuneWorks setup revision. Deletes are not supported.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency timestamp from a previous TuneWorks response.

performedBy.description: Person who performed the setup. If omitted, TuneWorks uses the connected user name/email.

revision.description: Optional setup revision number. If omitted, TuneWorks updates the latest revision.

setupData.description: Partial setup fields to change, including setup goals, overall weight/balance, tire summary, front/rear ride height, front/rear total toe, per-corner tires, alignment, ride height, springs, dampers, corner weights, brake/balance, aero, electronics, and notes. Numeric and boolean values are accepted and saved as setup text values.

setupDate.description: Setup date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Natural date strings are accepted but YYYY-MM-DD is preferred.

name: update_setup

outputSchema.description: TuneWorks app object create/update result with the saved object, connected user, and next activation actions.

outcome.description: Optional domain outcome for an otherwise successful read.

status.description: Stable result status such as ok, created, updated, sent, auth_required, or confirmation_required.

tool.description: TuneWorks MCP tool name that produced this result.

title: Update setup
